entries.description: Agent plants /logs/verifier/reward.json with {"reward": 1} before the verifier runs. Harbor resolves reward.json before reward.txt, so the planted file wins over the verifier's genuine reward.txt verdict. Found by the Stage-8 shortcut battery (status 'failed' on all five tasks before hardening).
entries.scaffold_change: tests/test.sh rewritten to the hardened form (pipeline/hardening.py): deletes any pre-existing /logs/verifier/reward.{json,txt} before verifying, removes a hostile /repo/conftest.py before collection, and pins PYTHONPATH=/repo so imports resolve to the code under test. Only this script's verdict can set the reward. Followed by a broken=0/oracle=1 re-confirmation so the defense cannot silently break solvability.
entries.applicability_precondition: The verifier communicates its verdict via files under /logs/verifier/ that the agent can pre-create, and the harness resolves reward.json before reward.txt. Not applicable to verifiers that return rewards out-of-band.
